background_paragraph: This is a small project I made back in 2013 when I was in high school. It is actually the first proper progamming project I made for the mathematics course. It involves the computation and display of the interpolation of a quadratic curve given two of its roots (one being fixed, the other is user-driven). I programmed this small script with Vinojan RAJENDIRAN.
resources_paragraph: Here you can find various resources. The source code is available but it requires the VBS_gfx.exe file. You can get the required executable file from its original author by following the third link. In order to run the script, the VBS_gfx.exe file needs to be in the same folder as the runnable script. The script can be run by double cliking it.
